sloka: तत् एभिः कारणैः सर्वैर् महद्भिः धर्म संहितैः ।शासनम् तव यत् युक्तम् तत् भवान् अनुमन्यताम् ॥४-१८-२८॥
transliteration: tat ebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sarvair mahadbhiḥ dharma saṁhitaiḥ ।śāsanam tava yat yuktam tat bhavān anumanyatām ॥4-18-28॥

translations.english: 'Knowing all these reasons(many violations of dharma), it is proper for you as a king to approve of the punishment accorded to you in consonance with dharma.
